title: AI and AGI: separating what exists from what is promised

videos.script: Every week brings a headline that a model can now do something new. {{headline}} Some of those claims are true. Some describe one good run out of many. Some describe a goal as if it had arrived. {{three}} This lesson gives you the words to tell them apart. {{words}} AI is a field, and a large language model is one small part of it. {{field}} AGI is a goal, and nobody agrees on what would count as reaching it. {{goal}} Then you read a claim the way an engineer would. What was measured, on which test, and whether the test was already in the training data. {{measure}} You will see a tiny model score perfectly on a test it had memorised. And you will see one lucky answer in ten that would make a convincing demo. {{demo}}
